title: Welcome to AegisDocs & AegisOS Desktop
author: AegisOS User
content:
Welcome to AegisDocs & AegisOS Desktop

You are editing a live document inside AegisOS — an autonomous, self-healing operating system with dual A/B zero-reboot hot-swapping.

What is AegisDocs?

AegisDocs is an end-user WYSIWYG document editor and page publisher (like Microsoft Word or Google Docs) running as a native application on top of the AegisOS kernel.

Key Features:

  • Full Rich Text Formatting: Style headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, underline, lists, quotes, tables, and colors.
  • AI Writing Co-Pilot: Powered by gemini-4-hydrogen to rewrite, summarize, generate, or polish text in real-time.
  • One-Click Page Publishing: Click Publish to turn this document into a standalone, shareable web page with its own URL.
  • Dual Partition Cloud Sync: All documents persist in storage/documents/ and automatically synchronize between Localhost and the Live Mirror (demo.liquidviz.com).

Start writing above or click AI Co-Pilot to collaborate with the kernel neural engine!
